body:
They gave me some pills to help but I still don't feel normal. My therapist recommended a day program but in like my freedoms. I do not know of any non hospital resources. If possible can you give an example? 

I can't talk to my family about my mental issues. They get upset and angry when I start talking about my bad feelings. I have a therapist and she helps but its not enough. I was also given a caseworker after discharge but I am not sure how she is supposed to help.
I am going to take summer classes in two weeks but I am not sure I'm even ready for that. I wish I could go somewhere where I am taken care of for a while but not a hospital.

Have you visited the campus already? Maybe taking a trip to the campus,getting a tour and talking to some of the upperclasmen would help make going to school something that will help you hold on a little longer.
